title: Returned-Amount Add-On Schedule for Kestrel Auto Finance Returned Payments
content:
A returned-amount add-on on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts follows the full amount of the most recent returned payment — the full payment amount shown on the latest return entry in the loan history — and is added to the returned-payment fee for the registration state.

| Full amount of the most recent returned payment | Add-on |
|---|---|
| above the large-return limit of 500.00 | large-return add-on: 10.00 |
| above the medium-return limit of 300.00 and no more than 500.00 | medium-return add-on: 5.00 |
| 300.00 or less | no add-on |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Returned amount | Add-on |
|---|---|
| 500.01 | 10.00 |
| 500.00 | 5.00 |
| 300.01 | 5.00 |
| 300.00 | none |

## Points of judgement

- The amount read is the whole payment the bank returned, not the principal portion of it.
- Where the loan history shows more than one return, the latest return entry decides the add-on.
- Hypothetical: a returned payment of 612.40 on a vehicle whose registration-state fee is 30.00 gives 30.00 plus 10.00, that is 40.00.
